user.title: MelcoBEMS A1M bus
user.description: Connect the RS-485 bus carrying your A1M interfaces. List the units as `address:Name` pairs, e.g. `1:Kitchen 1, 2:Kitchen 2`. Each unit is probed and must answer as an Air-To-Air system.

reconfigure.title: Change how Home Assistant reaches the A1M bus
reconfigure.description: Switch this bus between a USB serial adapter and a network Modbus TCP gateway (set the gateway to Modbus TCP ⇄ RTU, same baud/8N1 as the A1Ms). Your units, entities, history and options stay as they are. Every unit is probed on the new connection before anything is saved.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open the serial port / TCP connection. Is another integration (e.g. the built-in modbus hub) holding the port?
error.invalid_slaves: Could not parse the unit list — use e.g. `1:Kitchen 1, 2:Kitchen 2` with addresses 1-247.
error.slave_failed: One or more units did not validate (no reply, or not an Air-To-Air system). {bad}
error.host_required: Enter the gateway’s host name or IP address.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Connection updated. The integration has reloaded on the new connection.

init.title: A1M options
init.description: Setpoint Offset: pick an external room temperature sensor per unit and enable the feed — Home Assistant will keep the A1M supplied with the real room temperature so the unit thermostats on it (instead of its return-air reading). Feeds auto-disable when a sensor goes stale and on shutdown.
